# Architecture of Sarah

This repository carries its own architecture specification, generated from
Ergane. It is in `architecture/`, as a knowledge graph: `graph.json` for the
artifacts and the relationships between them, `entities/` for each
artifact's typed data, `definitions/` for what the fields mean, and
`models/` for the architecture models in FINOS CALM. The architecture
description documents are the markdown files beside this one, in
`architecture/`.

**The specification is authoritative.** Where the code and the
specification disagree, that is a finding to report, not a licence to
change the specification. Nothing under `architecture/` may be hand-edited:
it is regenerated on every publish, so an edit made there is lost. Ergane
owns `architecture/` and exactly the paths listed under
`ownership.machineOwnedPaths` in `architecture/manifest.json`, and nothing
else in this repository.

## Skills

These are installed as skills under `.agents/skills/` — the cross-tool
location — and under `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code, which reads only
that one. If your agent loads skills, it will reach for them by itself; if
it does not, read the one that matches what you are doing.

- **`architecture-orientation`** (`.agents/skills/architecture-orientation/SKILL.md`) — Read the architecture specification for Sarah before making a structural change or explaining how the system works — adding, removing or moving a component, changing a boundary, an interface or a data store, introducing a dependency between parts, or answering how the pieces fit together. Not needed for a change that stays inside one module.
- **`architecture-change-proposal`** (`.agents/skills/architecture-change-proposal/SKILL.md`) — Propose a change to the architecture record for Sarah when the code needs the specification to change — a component that now exists, a responsibility that has moved, a decision taken in code, a requirement that turned out to be wrong. The specification cannot be edited in this repository; use this skill instead of editing it.
- **`architecture-drift-check`** (`.agents/skills/architecture-drift-check/SKILL.md`) — Check the code in this repository against the architecture specification for Sarah and report where the two disagree — a component in the model with no code behind it, code with no component, a dependency the model does not have, a decision the code contradicts. Use it when asked to review, audit or check conformance, and before a release.
- **`architecture-implementation`** (`.agents/skills/architecture-implementation/SKILL.md`) — Build or change code to deliver a requirement of Sarah (a ticket, a feature or a fix the architecture describes). Finds the requirement, the decisions and models that govern it, says how far to trust each, and what to ask instead of guessing. Use it before writing code for a ticket.
